@@U00650@@
(Shouting.)

@@U00651@@
He thought he had love in his belly!

@@U00653@@
(Sings.)

@@U00654@@
He scampered in,
He scampered out,
He lapped up puddles
With his fuzzy snout;
He tore up the house,
He gnawed at the door,
He scratched and rolled
Around on the floor.
He hopped and pranced,
His pain was so great,
But it did him no good,
Early or late.
He thought he had love in his belly.

@@U00656@@
(Shouting.)

@@U00657@@
He thought he had love in his belly!

@@U00659@@
(Sings.)

@@U00660@@
In terror he ran straight
Into the kitchen
In the light of day,
Twistin and twitchin’,
And lay on the hearth,
And started to shake,
As if his little
Rat’s heart would break.
The murderess rose up
And started to gloat:
“Ha, he’s tuning
His last note!
As if he had love in his belly.”

@@U00662@@
(Shouting.)

@@U00663@@
As if he had love in his belly.
translation:
@@U00650@@
（喊叫。）

@@U00651@@
他以为他肚子里有爱情！

@@U00653@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00654@@
他蹦蹦跳跳地进去了，
他一溜烟跑了出去，
他舔起水坑
带着毛茸茸的鼻子；
他拆毁了房子，
他咬着门，
他又抓又滚
周围的地板上。
他又蹦又跳，
他的痛苦是如此之大，
但这对他没有任何好处，
早或晚。
他以为他肚子里有爱。

@@U00656@@
（喊叫。）

@@U00657@@
他以为他肚子里有爱情！

@@U00659@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00660@@
惊恐之下他径直跑了过去
走进厨房
在白天的光辉下，
扭动和抽搐，
并躺在炉边，
并开始颤抖，
仿佛他的小
老鼠的心会碎的。
凶手站了起来
并开始幸灾乐祸：
“哈，他在调音
他最后的笔记！
就好像他肚子里藏着爱一样。”

@@U00662@@
（喊叫。）

@@U00663@@
仿佛他的肚子里藏着爱情。
